title: ChecklistItem
description: Standardized schema for actionable, situation-calibrated security checklist items with scoring weights and SPOF validation.

description.description: Operational instructions, justification, and threat modeling rationale.

pillarId.description: Foreign key into taxonomy security pillar (e.g. PIL-FINANCIAL).

phaseId.description: Foreign key into travel lifecycle phase (e.g. PHS-INGRESS).

criticality.description: Impact level on physical or financial safety.

isSPOF.description: If true, failure to verify this item triggers an instant Single Point of Failure alert.

minimumRiskTier.description: Minimum destination risk tier that mandates this item.

decisionTableRef.description: Optional ID of decision table that dynamically dictates this item's parameters.

truthTableRef.description: Optional ID of truth table validating conditional execution.

scoringDeductionPoints.description: Readiness penalty points deducted if item is unresolved.

recommendedGearSkus.description: Catalog product SKUs that satisfy or harden this checklist requirement.
